headline: Gemini in Chrome replaces most extensions with AI-powered features
summary: Google's AI model Gemini integrates with Chrome to summarize tabs, fill forms, and more
details: The author of Android Police ditched most Chrome extensions after trying Gemini's capabilities. Gemini can summarize tabs, fill forms, and even draft text based on the page's context.

Gemini's features include reading active tabs, answering questions, and summarizing content without sharing browsing history with developers. It also integrates with NotebookLM to turn summaries into podcasts or videos.

While Gemini can handle tasks like price comparison and coupon application, some features are limited by availability and subscription tiers. The AI model is not meant to replace serious extensions like password managers or developer tools.

Gemini's image generation capabilities are still limited, producing a solid color fill instead of a transparent PNG when removing backgrounds. However, it can be useful for quick mock-ups or product shots.
The integration of Gemini with Chrome signals a shift towards AI-powered browsing features, potentially disrupting the extension economy.
caption:
Can Gemini in Chrome really replace your extensions?

The author of Android Police ditched most Chrome extensions after trying Gemini's capabilities. Gemini can summarize tabs, fill forms, and even draft text based on the page's context.

Gemini's features include reading active tabs, answering questions, and summarizing content without sharing browsing history with developers. It also integrates with NotebookLM to turn summaries into podcasts or videos.

While Gemini can handle tasks like price comparison and coupon application, some features are limited by availability and subscription tiers. The AI model is not meant to replace serious extensions like password managers or developer tools.

Gemini's image generation capabilities are still limited, producing a solid color fill instead of a transparent PNG when removing backgrounds. However, it can be useful for quick mock-ups or product shots.

The integration of Gemini with Chrome signals a shift towards AI-powered browsing features, potentially disrupting the extension economy.

#AI #Google #Chrome #Gemini

Source: Android Police, Tom's Hardware
